id.description: Unique id; links may name it.

label.description: The group's name, centred at its top.

sublabel.description: One line under the name: the host, the region, who shares it.

tiers.description: The dashed boxes inside, top to bottom.

parts.description: Parts listed straight on the group (no tiers): drawn as one untitled tier.

cols.description: Columns for `parts` listed straight on the group; default one column.
